name: Android Build Environment
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && cd ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip && unzip -q commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip && mkdir -p latest && mv bin lib source.properties latest/ && rm commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip && echo 'export ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/android-sdk' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'export PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools' >> ~/.bashrc && export ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/android-sdk && export PATH=$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools && yes | sdkmanager --licenses --sdk_root=${ANDROID_HOME} && sdkmanager --sdk_root=${ANDROID_HOME} "platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" "build-tools;33.0.0"
